title: Time Jump: 17:20 — Device Network Isolation Confirmed

fields.narration: Facilitator → All: It is now 17:20 on Thursday, March 12, 2026. The device network (10.40.x.x) has been isolated for one hour. Central telemetry remains dark. The extra RNs are arriving on shift. The loaner pumps are en route — a courier van is 12 minutes from the main entrance. Clinical Engineering has re-flashed 22 pumps from the offline 4.2.1 copy. The pump server ORRMC-PUMP01 remains untrusted. No further remote access is permitted. The vendor session broker ORRMC-VSB01 is still offline. The HCC remains at Level 2.

instructorNote: This jump advances the timeline to recovery phase. The team must now decide on verification and restoration steps. Watch for early attempts to restore EHR or pump connectivity without full validation.
